Abstract

A valve core for a pneumatic tyre valve comprises a body, a poppet movable in the body, and a compliant seat formed of a superelastic alloy. On inflation the poppet over-travels beyond its sealing position to open a purge gap between the poppet and the seat, so that sealant deposits are carried back into the tyre & cleared from the sealing face.

Claims (3)

The invention claimed is:
1. A valve core comprising:
a body defining a bore;
a poppet movable in the bore between a closed position and an open position; and
a seat engaged by the poppet in the closed position, the seat being compliant.
2. The valve core of claim 1, wherein the seat comprises a superelastic alloy.
3. The valve core of claim 1, wherein the poppet over-travels by 0.2 mm to 0.8 mm.

Description

FIELD OF THE INVENTION
The invention relates to valve cores for pneumatic tyre valves, and in particular to valve cores used with liquid tyre sealant.
BACKGROUND
Liquid sealant drawn into the valve during inflation dries on the seat and poppet, causing leakage or blockage. Known cores address this with low-adhesion coatings, which reduce adhesion but do not remove a formed film.
